key_findings: Electroacupuncture reversed CFA-induced mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia, and AM251 abolished the effect.
Electroacupuncture raised DRG CB1 (co-localized with Nav1.8) and reduced Nav1.8 and COX-2 protein.
